Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggfortify) 
source("src/utils.R")
```

Load data
```{r}
mega_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_cluster != "cDC1+") 
```

Matrices with entropy and density values per patient
```{r}
### Entropy values
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy, R.NR, PFS, PFS_event) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") 

### Density values
df_density = mega_clusters %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") 

traitData = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::select(R.NR, PFS, PFS_event)

df_entropy = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::select(-R.NR, -PFS, -PFS_event)

#write.csv(df_entropy, file = "../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv")
#write.csv(df_density, file = "../input/MegaClusters_density.csv")
```

CD8 enrichment in megaclusters
```{r}
ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = Spatial_cluster)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters",
       x = "Megaclusters",
       y = "Entropy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

CD8 enrichment per megacluster comparing response information
```{r}
ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Megaclusters density per megacluster comparing response
```{r}
ggplot(mega_clusters, aes(x = Cluster_type, y = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Megaclusters density by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Heatmap for megaclusters
```{r}
## Heatmap annotations
ann_colors <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Response = traitData$R.NR, 
  
  col = list(
    Response = c("R" = "green", "NR" = "red")
  ),
  
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                 legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))
)

## Heatmap

## Proportions
dend_column = as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(scale(df_density)), method = "ward.D2"))

ht1 = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(df_density)), 
        border = T, cluster_columns = dend_column, 
        top_annotation = ann_colors, column_gap = unit(8, "mm"), 
        name = "Megaclusters density", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"), 
        column_dend_reorder = T, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_heatmap_legend = T, 
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16), 
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize =12), 
        width = unit(25, "cm"), height = unit(10, "cm"), na_col = "grey90",
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                    legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))


pdf("Results/Density_megaclusters_clusters", width = 20, height = 10)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht1, show_heatmap_legend = T, heatmap_legend_side = "left", annotation_legend_side = 'left')
dev.off()
```

Cluster patient groups based on megacluster density
```{r}
hc = hclust(dist(scale(df_density)), method = "ward.D2")
k = 5
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)
plot(hc, main = "Patients groups", xlab = "", sub = "", cex = 0.8)
rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = 2:4)

coldata = traitData %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = clusters)
```

Remove outliers (patient groups with 1 sample)
```{r}
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Groups %in% c(1,2,4))

df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%rownames(coldata),] ## Subset to only patients within the patient groups
```

PCA of megacluster densities
```{r}
# Ensure Groups is in the data
df_plot <- as.data.frame(df_density)
df_plot$Groups <- factor(coldata$Groups)  # add Groups column

# Run PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(scale(df_density), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# Plot PCA
autoplot(pca_result, data = df_plot, 
         colour = 'Groups',   # column name as string
         label = FALSE, 
         size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA of df_density") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(colour = "Patient groups")
```

Megaclusters densities split by patient clusters
```{r}
## Heatmap annotations
ann_colors <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(

  col = list(

  ),

                                 legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))
)

ht1 = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(df_density_proportions)), 
        border = T, cluster_columns = F, column_split = coldata$Groups,
        top_annotation = ann_colors, column_gap = unit(8, "mm"), 
        name = "Megaclusters density", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"), 
        column_dend_reorder = T, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_heatmap_legend = T, 
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16), 
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize =12), 
        width = unit(25, "cm"), height = unit(10, "cm"), na_col = "grey90",
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                    legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))


pdf("Results/Density_megaclusters_split_by_clusters", width = 20, height = 10)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht1, show_heatmap_legend = T, heatmap_legend_side = "left", annotation_legend_side = 'left')
dev.off()
```

Survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.by.groups(scale(df_density), coldata, "months", p.value = 1)
```

Save patient group info

save(coldata, file = "Patients_groups.RData")
